sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition from Fulu-era BeaconState to EIP-7928 BeaconState during the fork upgrade

nodes.label: Pre-Fork Fulu BeaconState
nodes.description: System is running Fulu-era consensus with Fulu BeaconState structure

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_eip7928()
nodes.description: Transform Fulu BeaconState into EIP-7928 BeaconState by copying all fields and extending ExecutionPayloadHeader with block_access_list_root

nodes.label: Post-Fork EIP-7928 BeaconState
nodes.description: System is running EIP-7928 consensus with updated BeaconState including block_access_list_root in ExecutionPayloadHeader

nodes.label: Fork Condition Not Met
nodes.description: Current epoch does not match EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH; system continues in Fulu state

nodes.label: Fork Conditions Validated
nodes.description: Both slot alignment and epoch match conditions are satisfied

nodes.label: Update Fork Version Record
nodes.description: Set previous_version to current fork version, update current_version to EIP7928_FORK_VERSION, record transition epoch

edges.label: Slot is at epoch boundary; check epoch value
Proceed to update fork metadata in state

ambiguities.text: Configuration is 'not definitive' - fork version and epoch values marked as TBD
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume current placeholder values (0x0b000000 for version, max uint64 for epoch) are for testing only. Actual values will be set before mainnet deployment.

ambiguities.text: No specification of how block_access_list_root is computed or validated post-fork
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the execution layer is responsible for computing and populating this root in subsequent blocks. Validation rules likely defined in a companion EIP or execution spec.

implicit_assumptions.description: The system has successfully completed the Fulu fork before EIP-7928 activation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: State structure mismatch during upgrade; upgrade_to_eip7928() expects Fulu BeaconState fields that would not exist

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network upgrade their software before EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network partition between nodes running old and new fork versions; potential consensus failure
